content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Home medical equipment and supplies delivered to patients and billed to insurers, unlike GoodRx's consumer drug savings and telehealth platform."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures generic injectable and inhaled drugs for hospitals and wholesalers, while GoodRx runs a consumer savings platform and does not make drugs."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells cloud practice software and outsourced billing to providers, a different business from consumer prescription savings."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Shares GoodRx's model of pharma advertising on a free platform plus telehealth, though its audience is physicians rather than consumers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Develops and manufactures generic controlled-release drugs for pharma partners, not a consumer prescription savings platform."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Clinical lab testing and contract trial services are a different business, despite some consumer-directed test ordering."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells patient experience and employee survey subscriptions to hospitals, not prescription savings or pharmacy-facing services."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Runs prescription savings and affordability programs with pharma-paid platform fees and transaction fees, closely matching GoodRx's model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Diversified maker of medical, dental and infection products plus coding software, not a consumer prescription savings platform."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Hospital EHR and revenue cycle software and outsourcing sold to rural hospitals, unlike GoodRx's consumer and pharma-facing model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Cloud software for life sciences companies, with no consumer prescription savings, pharmacy or telehealth business."}]}
